results.content: The latest Quinnipiac University showed Trump's approval rating at 32%, while 58% of respondents said they disapproved of the president's job performance. According to the pollster, Trump’s performance in the poll is the worst recorded in either of his terms in the White House. Nearly half the voters surveyed also said they are "worse off financially" then they were one year ago and 88% said they feel inflation is a very serious or somewhat serious problem. [...] One factor leading to low ratings could be linked to the concern that Trump has not backed the right issues and is out of touch with the problems ordinary Americans face, according to the CNN poll.
